Audible Disease browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type volume/amplification tremolo browse by enclosure pedal Audible Disease FR-1 Fracture Published on November 28, 2008 Audible Disease distortion tremolo lfo-controlled pedal Information Audible Disease The Audible Disease Fracture FR-1 is a dilapidated high-gain oscillating distortion and tremolo unit designed to bring broken audio hurting to your sound. Controls allow you to adjust the speed of the tremolo sound (the SPEED knob) as well as the oscillation of the distorted sound (the STAGGER knob). The LED next to the SPEED knob gives you a visual cue as to how fast the tremolo is pulsing. Tremolo speeds range from extremely fast to extremely slow (about 60 milliseconds to 3.4 seconds). Plug it in for laods of decayed audio torment! Operates with either a 9-volt battery or a standard 9-volt negative tip barrel type adapter (not included).
